title: Mapping the Emotional Bottleneck: Does Disrupting Middle-Layer Affect Representations Predict Jailbreak Success?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If affective middle-layer suppression is a necessary causal step in jailbreaks, cheap probes on those layers become robust detectors. Clear chain from mechanistic finding to cost-effective detection, directly addressing an open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training linear classifiers on middle-layer activations requires extracting representations from Llama-3-8B on a single GPU. This is feasible with medium compute and mentorship, but activation extraction pipelines are non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Comparing affect suppression across multiple jailbreak families and testing necessary vs. sufficient conditions involves multiple experimental conditions. Could be narrowed to 2-3 jailbreak families to fit 20 hours, but as stated it stretches.
